description: IBM® Rational® provides a full range of offerings to ensure software and systems delivery success through practical, reliable, and extensible components. Designed with the needs of business users in mind, Rational® offerings provide flexible, time-saving technologies that are developed for immediate productivity, high-fidelity results, and cost-savings. With Rational offerings users can consistently deliver assets to meet and exceed business commitments. Whether you work as an individual contributor or as a member of a team, Rational offerings meet your needs with powerful technologies optimized for competitive success.

labeler.rationale: This is a broad description of software and systems delivery components focused on productivity, results, and cost savings; it does not specify AI functionality.
evidence_spans: Rational® offerings provide flexible, time-saving technologies that are developed for immediate productivity, high-fidelity results, and cost-savings.

blind.rationale: The text describes a broad software and systems delivery offering focused on productivity, reliable components, and delivery of assets to business commitments, without an AI-specific function.
evidence_spans: Rational® offerings provide flexible, time-saving technologies that are developed for immediate productivity, high-fidelity results, and cost-savings.
With Rational offerings users can consistently deliver assets to meet and exceed business commitments.

parent_concerns: Both proposals mark supported but Rational text is broad productivity/competitive-success marketing. Identify concrete conventional software functions actually supplied rather than importing known Rational capabilities or relying on absence of AI words. If insufficient retain weak/forced.

description:
The Pega Cloud subscription provides a fully managed cloud service platform running Pega Infinity™ and Pega Strategic Business Applications as-a-Service. Pega owns and manages Pega Cloud services, and provides clients with global and regional support models for 24x7 operations, security and monitoring to support the most demanding enterprise applications. Pega has devoted years of significant engineering to provide a complete ecosystem to run clients’ mission-critical Pega workloads.

A list of our services includes:
Operational system support and monitoring
Fault tolerant environments with multi-layer redundancy and backups
Fully scalable environments not constrained by server resource limits
Secure and hardened environments built with
Host-Based FW & IDS
Anti-Virus & Anti-Malware
File Integrity Monitoring
Data Management Services
Resiliency & Backup services built in
Management of Operating System
Network and Firewall configurations
Encryption of Data-At-Rest and Data-In-Transit
Pega Cloud is backed by a Production Availability SLA and a security/compliance strategy to support the strictest security postures that your business requires.

Pega Cloud assumes the responsibility for preparing and hosting comprehensive compliance audits, offering a service that has been independently audited and attested by many industries’ most demanding compliance requirements. Go to the Pega Trust Center to learn details.

labeler.rationale: This describes managed cloud hosting and operations, including monitoring, backups, firewall and operating-system management, encryption, and compliance audits.
evidence_spans:
Operational system support and monitoring
Fault tolerant environments with multi-layer redundancy and backups
Fully scalable environments not constrained by server resource limits

blind.rationale: The described cloud service hosts and manages enterprise application workloads, including monitoring, security controls, backups, operating systems, networking, and compliance audits—conventional cloud operations and infrastructure management.
evidence_spans: The Pega Cloud subscription provides a fully managed cloud service platform running Pega Infinity™ and Pega Strategic Business Applications as-a-Service.

Operational system support and monitoring
Fault tolerant environments with multi-layer redundancy and backups

parent_concerns: Distinguish managed hosting/support/security operations service from meaningful functionality of the described software platform. Do concrete described platform operations establish conventional software scope, or only managed services/entitlement? Do not infer Pega application features from names.

description: Abstract Syntax Notation One (ASN. 1) is a standard interface description language (IDL) for defining data structures that can be serialized and deserialized in a cross-platform way. It is broadly used in telecommunications and computer networking, and especially in cryptography.

labeler.rationale: It describes ASN.1 as a standard language for defining data structures and serialization/deserialization across platforms, a conventional data-format standard.
evidence_spans: a standard interface description language (IDL) for defining data structures that can be serialized and deserialized in a cross-platform way.

blind.rationale: ASN.1 is described as a standard interface-description language for defining data structures that can be serialized and deserialized across platforms, a conventional data-format specification function.
evidence_spans: is a standard interface description language (IDL) for defining data structures that can be serialized and deserialized in a cross-platform way.

parent_concerns: Text defines a language/serialization STANDARD, not a software implementation. A specification being used in computing does not alone establish a conventional software product. Assess binary evidence/forced flags under software-scope requirement.
